caption:
12% of 25? Flip it.

a% of b always equals b% of a. So 12% of 25 is the same as 25% of 12, which is just a quarter of 12.

Save this for test day.

youtube.title: The Percent Flip Trick: 12% of 25 in 2 Seconds | SAT
youtube.description: Two quick percent calculations using the swap trick a% of b = b% of a. SAT-style practice question (original).
